details.description: Command-specific JSON refusal context, deliberately open.

source_sha256.description: Source identity. The file hash when the recording names its first video stream.

replaced_manifest_sha256.description: Previous source seal, or null when unchanged.

replaced_path.description: Path of the replaced source record, or null.

decode_policy_current.description: Whether decoded facts use the installed policy.

lineage.description: Whether and how the version is linked.

Source identity. The file hash when the recording names its first video stream.

not_compared.description: Predecessors whose major keeps no comparison projection, present only when one exists.

reason.description: Why it could not be compared.

unlinked.description: Other corpus versions on this data root that place a source of this version in another group or split. Absent when there is nothing to report. The build still succeeds.

placements.description: Sources placed elsewhere, ordered by source hash, then by the other version's name.

items.description: One source held by this version and by another version.

source_sha256.description: Source identity. The file hash when the recording names its first video stream.

from.description: Where another version on this data root places the source.

to.description: Where this version places the source.

scan.description: Present when the corpus directory could not be listed, so no version was compared. Absent when the scan visited each version directory. The build still succeeds.

not_compared.description: Manifests on this data root that could not be read, or whose major keeps no projection. Present only when one exists, ordered by corpus version name.

items.description: One manifest the listing could not compare.

reason.description: Why the manifest was not compared.

near_duplicates.description: Likely re-encoded copies in different groups, at the measured perceptual threshold. The comparison reads the version being built, the chain its declaration links, and every other built version on the same data root. Absent when no pair meets the threshold, every window and version could be read, and the corpus directory could be listed. The build still succeeds, and this report is not sealed.

samples.description: How many frames of each window were sampled.

grid.description: Width and height of each frame's box-averaged luma grid.

threshold.description: Minimum normalized correlation reported as a likely copy.

pairs.description: Pairs at or above the threshold, ordered by corpus version and stream. Present only when one exists.

similarity.description: Normalized correlation of the two fingerprints, rounded to four decimal places.

streams.description: The two streams, ordered by corpus version then stream.

corpus_id.description: Corpus version that holds the stream.

scan.description: Present when the corpus directory could not be listed, so versions outside the declared chain were not compared. The declared chain is still compared. Absent when the scan visited each version directory. The build still succeeds.

not_compared.description: Windows or versions that could not be fingerprinted. Present only when one exists. A missing manifest and a version that cannot be read are unreadable.

reason.description: Why the window or version was not compared.

stream_ids.description: Streams that were not compared. Empty when the version has no readable stream list.

impact.description: Corpus versions on this data root that pin the source record this command replaced, each with its frames directory. Absent when nothing needs reporting, including a repeat that replaced nothing. The replacement is still recorded.

versions.description: Versions that pin the replaced record, ordered by corpus version name. A version is listed once however many of its streams pin it.

items.description: One corpus version that pins the replaced source record.

frames_directory.description: Directory that holds this version's staged frames, whether or not it currently contains files.

not_compared.description: Manifests on this data root that could not be read, or whose major keeps no projection. Present only when one exists, ordered by corpus version name. Such a version is not treated as absent.

items.description: One manifest the listing could not compare.

reason.description: Why the manifest was not compared.

scan.description: Present when the corpus directory could not be listed. Absent when the scan visited each version directory. The replacement is still recorded.

reused_from.description: Present when this bundle's frames were hard-linked from a linked corpus version. Absent when this run decoded the stream, left it unchanged, or verified it.

corpus_id.description: Linked version that held the frames.

stream_id.description: Stream whose bundle supplied the frames.

transform.description: Transform name, or identity for an original stream.

reason.description: Why it could not be compared.

host.description: Host facts, outside the frame-set identity.

kind.description: Comparison record kind, when embedded in a result.

host.description: Host facts, outside the frame-set identity.
Host facts, outside the frame-set identity.

source_sha256.description: Source identity. The file hash when the recording names its first video stream.

parent_stream_id.description: Parent stream, or null for original stream.

frame_count.description: Number of frames on the left.

differing_frames.description: Number of indexes with missing or differing hash or PTS.

first_differing_frame.description: Smallest differing source frame index, or null.

reason.description: Reason a draft has no frozen version.

items.description: Historic major with no frozen contract.

status.description: Disposition: facts while a retained record has a route, retired once none needs one.

reason.description: Why no retained runtime evidence needs a contract.

migration.description: What a holder of a record of this major must do.

seal_checked.description: Whether the input record seal was checked.

required_bump.description: Minimum compatible schema bump; none for an unchanged or initial candidate.

pointer.description: JSON pointer into the candidate schema, or the previous schema for removal.

preview.description: Contact sheet of one parent frame beside its generated cases.

encoder.description: Pinned PNG encoder. Stored deflate, so bytes do not depend on a zlib build.

oneOf.description: The parent frame, with no outline.
A generated case whose frame is present.

region.description: Outlined rectangle. Absent when this frame is outside the case window.

oneOf.description: A generated case that removed this frame.

inventory_count.description: Candidate inventories of a discovery run, one per stream.

candidate_count.description: Candidate windows across a discovery run.

feature_row_count.description: Feature rows across a discovery run's extractors and streams.

hint_sources.description: What became of each hint source's matches, in ascending hint_source_id order.

unmapped.description: Matches that named no window, by reason.

selection.description: What a discovery run's selection decided across its candidates.

budget.description: Most candidates the method may select.

excluded.description: Candidates excluded from ranking, by reason in ascending order.

reason.description: Why the candidates were not ranked.

unavailable_scores.description: Scores a discovery run could not compute, by score_id and then reason in ascending order.

items.description: Candidates missing one score for one reason.

count.description: Candidates without the score for this reason.

coverage.description: What each extractor of a discovery run saw of the staged frames, in ascending extractor_id order: the least over the run's streams.

covered_fraction.description: Share of a frame's area the model input shows. The tiles of one grid together cover the whole frame.

scale.description: Model input pixels per frame pixel along one side: a target this many frame pixels wide is this times as wide in the model input.

links.description: What a link review holds, counted.

status.description: clear: every link is decided. unresolved: at least one is not.

states.description: Links per status, ascending by status.

unresolved_cross_split.description: Undecided links whose groups sit in different splits.

flagged.description: Links each method and extractor flagged, ascending.

not_compared.description: Entries of streams a method could not compare.

decisions_outside_links.description: Decisions that name no link of the version; present when a decisions file was given.

queue.description: What a discovery run offers for review, counted.

offers.description: Offered windows per reason, ascending; a window may have several reasons.

withheld.description: Pool streams whose offered windows review withheld, ascending by stream.

reason.description: locked_without_policy: the stream is in the locked split and no custodian policy allows its review.

not_offered.description: Pool windows neither selected nor drawn by the audit sample.

declaration_path.description: Local path of the declaration written: a review template or an exported corpus declaration.

declaration_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exported declaration's bytes.

review.description: What a review made of its run, counted.

offered.description: Windows the run offered for review.

withheld.description: Windows of locked streams review withheld.

frame_count.description: Source frames the frozen version selects.

superseded.description: The versions the frozen one supersedes, against which the reviewer's related decisions were applied.

not_compared.description: Versions whose format holds no placement, nearest first.

reason.description: other_schema: its major keeps no comparison projection.

source_inventory.description: Counts of upstream video inventory statuses and unresolved facts.

collection_count.description: Number of source collections in this inventory.

video_count.description: Number of videos in this inventory, including excluded and unknown entries.

path.description: Local path of the normalized source inventory declaration.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the normalized source inventory declaration.

blind.description: Counts for a blinded audit presentation or its unblinding. It names no recording, score or offer reason. Independence and blinding, when present, are declarations, not a check that the procedure was followed.

presented.description: Audit-sample windows in the blinded packet.

withheld.description: Locked audit-sample windows withheld from the packet.

outside_sample.description: Pool windows the audit sample did not draw.

run_count.description: Discovery runs that share this audit sample.

unselected.description: Presented windows at least one named run did not select.

independence.description: Whether independence was declared. Absent on the presentation command. Not a verification.

blinding.description: Whether blinding was declared. Absent on the presentation command. Not a verification.

reviewer_minutes.description: Minutes the reviewer recorded. Absent on the presentation command.

budget.description: Selection budget the two runs share.

runs.description: The ssl-diverse run and the uniform baseline. These counts are selection metrics, not the blinded presentation.

unique_reviewed_pool_windows.description: Pool windows that have an observation after the two reviews are matched.

unique_offered_windows.description: Windows offered by either run, counted once.

review_blinding.description: The blinding value both reviews stated, unrecorded when both omit it, or mixed when they differ. A stated value is a declaration, not a verification that the procedure was followed, and pictures may still show the source. This is not the blind count object.

review_independence.description: The independence value both reviews stated, unrecorded when both omit it, or mixed when they differ. A stated value is a declaration, not a verification that the procedure was followed.

review_effort_minutes.description: Minutes the two reviews recorded, the diverse review then the uniform review. Null when that review did not state effort.

prefixItems.description: Minutes the diverse review recorded, or null.
Minutes the uniform review recorded, or null.

whole_stream_target_observed.description: Streams whose every pool window has a target-present observation. A stream with a missing observation is not listed.

audit.description: Stratified finite-population estimate of target recall for the paired selections. estimated carries recall and gain. inconclusive withholds recall when evidence is missing, and withholds an interval when variance is unavailable. A negative gain is valid.

status.description: Whether the paired recall was estimated.

strata.description: One entry per audit stratum, in the run's order.

weighted_observations.description: Population-weighted observation counts. Unknown includes sampled windows with a missing observation and is not target absence.

weighted_observations_complete.description: False when the population is empty or any stratum has no sample or an unknown observation.

weighted_selected_targets.description: Population-weighted target-present windows each method selected.

diverse.description: Weighted targets the diverse run selected.

uniform.description: Weighted targets the uniform run selected.

reasons.description: Why recall or an interval was withheld. Empty when status is estimated.

recall.description: Recall of weighted target-present windows for each method, or null when the estimate is withheld.

interval_95.description: Approximate 95 percent interval, clamped to [0, 1], or null when variance is unavailable.
Approximate 95 percent interval, clamped to [0, 1], or null when variance is unavailable.

gain.description: Diverse recall minus uniform recall, or null when the estimate is withheld. A negative value remains valid.

estimate.description: Point estimate of the paired difference.

interval_95.description: Approximate 95 percent interval, clamped to [-1, 1], or null when variance is unavailable.

x-rules.unknown: An unknown or missing audit observation is not target absence. No sample, no observed target, or unavailable variance leaves recall or its interval null rather than zero.

observations.description: Reviewed pool windows in stream and candidate order, with both selection decisions. An observation is not a label.

observation.description: What the reviewer saw. target_present: a target in at least one frame. target_absent: no target seen, which is not a verified absence. confuser: no target, but a moving object that could be mistaken for one. unknown: the reviewer could not tell, or the window was not observed. An observation is not a label.

audit_sampled.description: Whether the audit sample drew this window.

diverse_selected.description: Whether the diverse run selected this window.

uniform_selected.description: Whether the uniform run selected this window.

motion.description: The window's motion score in the diverse run, or null when it was not computed.

motion_rank.description: Rank of that score among the distinct computed motion scores of the diverse run, from 1 for the greatest, ties sharing a rank, or null when motion is null.

audit_misses_by_observation.description: Audit-sampled windows the diverse run did not select, by observation. An observation is absent when its count is zero. An observation is not a label.

confuser.description: Missed audit windows observed as confusers.

unknown.description: Missed audit windows observed as unknown.

limits.description: What this comparison does not establish: observations are not labels, discovery did not record compute cost, and recorded blinding is a declaration while pictures may show the source.

x-rules.outcome: Refused requires code, message and details. Success fields are those of the invoked command. Unchanged retains the fields of import, amendment, build or staging, so status alone does not identify the shape.
x-rules.comparison: A successful comparison embeds the sealed comparison and adds record_path; record_path is not covered by its embedded seal.
x-rules.versions: This result format stamps no version of its own; schema_version, when present, belongs to the embedded comparison.

compared-run.description: One reviewed selection run in the paired comparison.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed this run, as the review or freeze states.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the review declaration, or the seal of the freeze record.

streams.description: Distinct streams of the selected windows.

groups.description: Distinct groups of the selected windows.

exclusions.description: Windows excluded from ranking, by reason. A reason is absent when its count is zero.

features_unavailable.description: Windows excluded because a score the method reads was not computed.

operator_excluded.description: Windows of a locked stream, which selection does not rank.

repeated_content.description: Windows excluded as repeated content. A candidate inventory can record this reason.

reviewed_pool_windows.description: Pool windows this review or freeze observed.

offered_windows.description: Windows the run offered for review.

withheld_windows.description: Windows of locked streams the queue withheld.

audit_selected_overlap.description: Selected windows that the audit sample also drew.

compute_cost.description: Discovery does not record compute cost, so this is null.

comparison-stratum.description: The sample and observation counts of one audit stratum.

stratum_id.description: Stratum, which is the encounter group.

sample_size.description: Sampled windows whose observations were read.

weight.description: Population divided by the sample size, or null when the stratum has no sample.

observations.description: Sampled windows by observation. Unknown is not target absence.

unknown.description: Sampled windows with a missing or unknown observation.
